thread:
Aisha Khan: Heads up — a vendor CSV we just imported to the ATS sent ~120 candidate invites with the wrong locale and the email-opt-out column flipped. Getting a couple compliance flags.
Noah Park: Ugh. Which fields are wrong?
Aisha Khan: Looks like locale column is 'en-GB' but should be 'en-US' for most. Also the opt_out_email column had 0/1 reversed.
Maya Rodriguez: That will cause some candidates to not get offer prep emails, and others to get duplicate reminders. Need a rollback/patch.
Noah Park: Is this from last night's bulk-invite job? job_id=2026-03-22-03:14
Aisha Khan: Yes — vendor feed 3 (Greenfield Recruiting). CSV sample snippet:```candidate_email,locale,opt_out_email
jane@example.com,en-GB,0
john@example.com,en-GB,1
```
Samir Patel: Looks like vendor used 0=opt-out, 1=opt-in. Our importer assumes 0=opt-in. Also they defaulted locale to en-GB.
Recruiting Bot: :warning: 118 invites sent in job 2026-03-22-03:14. Delivery rate: 100%.
Maya Rodriguez: Immediate plan: 1) Pause outgoing ATS reminder queue. 2) Backfill correct locale for affected candidates. 3) Re-run opt-out mapping and send corrections where needed. 4) Notify candidates where we sent duplicate or wrong emails.
Noah Park: I can pause the reminder queue (doing it now).
Samir Patel: I'll open a hotfix branch to invert opt_out mapping when vendor=greenfield until they fix feed. Patch will be in importer service: map opt_out_email = (vendor_flag == 'greenfield' ? 1 - value : value).
Aisha Khan: Can you also produce a list of impacted candidates so Comms can review messaging?
Samir Patel: Yep — running a query:```SELECT id,email,locale,opt_out_email FROM candidates WHERE source_vendor='greenfield' AND created_at>='2026-03-22';```
Recruiting Bot: Query queued, estimated rows: 118.
Maya Rodriguez: I'm drafting the candidate message. Keep it short and include opt-out instructions + apology.
Noah Park: After patch, we should re-import corrected CSV into a staging ATS and run a sanity script. Samir can you add a validation step to CI that checks vendor CSV boolean semantics?
Samir Patel: Yup — adding a unit test and a small integration check that asserts opt_out values map to our canonical schema. I'll also add a locale whitelist check (allowed: en-US,en-GB,fr-FR).
Aisha Khan: Assigning tasks: Samir - importer patch + tests; Noah - pause/verify queue + re-run; Maya - candidate comms draft; I'll handle vendor escalation and request a corrected feed.
Maya Rodriguez: Draft ready in #people-ops-drafts, please review: "Hi X — we recently sent invite emails with incorrect locale or communication settings. We've fixed the issue and apologize for any confusion. Reply here to opt-out immediately."
Noah Park: Queue paused and snapshot taken.
Samir Patel: Patch deployed to staging, running import dry-run against corrected CSV. Sanity script output: 118/118 locale mapping corrected, opt_out normalized.
Aisha Khan: Good. Vendor update: Greenfield acknowledged schema mismatch and will flip their boolean mapping. They promised a corrected feed by EOD.
Maya Rodriguez: Once legal signs off on the comms, we'll send the correction email. Also logging this as an incident for the month-end recruiting ops review.
Noah Park: Adding retro item: add vendor schema contract + sample file to onboarding checklist.
Aisha Khan: Thanks everyone — marking this blocked until vendor confirms fixed feed. Will update thread when vendor confirms. :thumbsup:
